purpose: checkout-only wrapper around the ocr CLI; not a copy of the upstream agent skill
local_patches: Skill name is ocr-project-review, not open-code-review
Credentials come from the skill-local .env through a dedicated provider and api_key_cmd
Whole-project review uses ocr scan with JSON output, not the upstream diff-review command
A generated temporary rule suppresses compiler/lint/style findings without editing project rules
The skill renders a custom Markdown report and requires an independent audit before finalizing
Scripts and workflow are AstrBot-specific; upstream CLI and docs remain the source of OCR behavior
